title: Hook push
what: The picture snaps in 20% over 300ms, holds for the whole sentence, and snaps back out over 300ms finishing exactly on the cut. A slight blur rides the two ramps and is zero while it holds. It scales the footage itself, not a layer over it, so captions and the hook card stay put. It must be told where to end: with no ending it holds the picture cropped for the rest of the video. Use `untilEndOf` and name the hook's last word -- `until` leaves as a phrase BEGINS, so naming the next sentence ends the zoom a fraction inside it.
when: The opening claim, and nothing else. It makes a vocal hook land harder by being already there while the words arrive. Anywhere else it stops reading as emphasis and starts reading as a camera drifting. One per video.
seen_in: aieditoradvancing -- the standard opener from here on
